answer-1: I'm called Mèle, a Storyboard Artist who started her journey in 2023. After my courses with the CG Master Academy, my goal is to straighten my skills in storytelling by creating projects alongside Clip Studio Paint, Storyboard Pro and Blender 3D. I love make my audience dream with  mystical adventures; create emotions and nostalgia with drama; elaborate suspense with actions.
answer-2: My imagination is limitless. Wandering and Experimenting thanks to my life experience and my cinematography knowledge, I can bring sequences and the direction requested  to give the emotion we expected to the audience.
